entities.summary: The Palazzo del Governo is an administrative building which serves as the Italian Prefecture headquarters in Grosseto, Tuscany. It was designed in a Neoclassical style by architect Vittorio Mariani and completed in 1927. The building is situated in the suburb of Porta Nuova, outside the city walls, and is bordered by Via Roma and Viale Guglielmo Oberdan, overlooking Piazza Fratelli Rosselli, commonly known as Piazza della Vasca.
